elements.content: Full-page photographic cover image of an urban Vietnamese cityscape, showing high-rise buildings, dense low-rise development, roads, and a river/canal running through the city with bridges. Overlaid chapter text reads “5” and “Huy động tài chính” on a dark translucent band near the lower-left/center. A vertical multicolor decorative strip runs along the left edge. Photographic credit text visible: “© Huy Thoai/Shutterstock” (also vertically along the right edge). The page header text at top reads “Việt Nam: Báo cáo về Khí hậu và Phát triển” and “Huy động tài chính.” Main message: chapter/section title page introducing financing mobilization.
elements.notes: No tables, charts, maps, or data diagrams on this page; only a cover-style figure/photo with overlaid text.
